preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and the restriction k must satisfy 1 <= k < n <= 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n - 1 and all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: The list of parent vertices must have n-1 elements, and each parent must be a valid vertex index.
The root vertex must be 1, and the first element of the parent list must be 1.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of different leaves that can be visited.
